headline: Elon Musk eyes Tesla and SpaceX merger
standfirst: The billionaire is exploring a potential combination of his two biggest companies.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Elon Musk confirmed he is considering a merger between Tesla and SpaceX.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Both companies have established special committees to evaluate the potential deal.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This would combine a major electric car maker with a dominant aerospace firm.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Wait for the committees to finish their internal reviews of the proposed merger.

caption:
Elon Musk is currently looking into a potential merger between his companies Tesla and SpaceX.

This news has been confirmed by six independent sources. Special committees are now tasked with looking at whether combining the two massive firms makes sense. We are waiting to see what these internal groups decide.
